definitions.explanation: The native Japanese counter for nine objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦みかん→みかん：01036_mikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{九|ここの}つ⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.english: There are nine in the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{九|ここの}つ⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{九|ここの}つ⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: I received nine apples, so I shared some with my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{九|ここの}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれて→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}した→練習：05323_renshuu⟧。
examples.english: The children divided into nine groups and each practiced a different song.

notes:
{九|ここの}つ is the native Japanese (⟦{和語|わご}→和語：12074_wago⟧) number nine, used as a general counter for objects. This counting system only goes up to ten and is used when no specific counter applies.

NATIVE COUNTING SYSTEM (⟦{和語|わご}→和語：12074_wago⟧):
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (1), ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ (2), ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧ (3), ⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧ (4), ⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧ (5)
- ⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧ (6), ⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧ (7), ⟦{八|やっ}つ→八つ：02979_yattsu⟧ (8), {九|ここの}つ (9), ⟦{十|とお}→十：00708_juu⟧ (10)

WHEN TO USE:
- General objects without specific counters
- Abstract things: ⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{九|ここの}つ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are nine reasons)
- Food items at restaurants: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{九|ここの}つ (nine apples)
- Age for children: {九|ここの}つ (nine years old, informal)

COMPARISON WITH SINO-JAPANESE:
- {九|ここの}つ: native counter (general objects)
- {九|きゅう}/{九|く}: Sino-Japanese reading (used with specific counters like {九人|きゅうにん}, {九個|きゅうこ})

NOTE: For numbers above ten, use Sino-Japanese numbers with appropriate counters.
